verdict.rationale: cubic delivers extensive AI-generated insights: automated PR review comments flagging bugs/security issues, AI-generated PR summaries, an AI wiki that indexes the codebase into diagrams/docs, analytics dashboards (AI coding, AI review, delivery) with PR-level insight data, and issue-analysis that checks PRs against linked Jira/Linear tickets. A community reviewer corroborates the quality of these AI-generated technical explanations as more useful than generic LLM output. Missing for 10: independent large-scale benchmarking of insight accuracy beyond one HN anecdote.
